title: Polynomial algebra model after scalar extension killing pi
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R, and compatible algebra structures from R and R2=R/(pi^2) to Cbar. Let d be prepared polynomial data [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation] and D its explicit lifting quotient. Write A=d.reducedQuotient and ak=d.reducedElement(k). Let c:Cbar to D/(pi D) be an R-algebra map sending epsilon(X_i) to x_i modulo pi. Let B be a commutative R-algebra and R2-algebra, with a compatible scalar tower, such that pi maps to zero in B. Choose a chart k and s in D whose image modulo pi is c(epsilon(reduced(a_k))). Set t=1 tensor s in B tensor_R D. Then the polynomial algebra on the finite set E_k over B tensor_R2 A[1/ak] is isomorphic as a B-algebra to (B tensor_R D)[1/t]. No field or prime assumption is made. Localizations are those of [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away].

source.place: Stacks Project, Tag 07CP (lemma-lifting), https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP; read from the online tag because the local TeX is absent.

proof.text: Because pi maps to zero in B, tensoring the presentation of D with B kills pi and pi squared. The difference between s and the original a_k lift belongs to pi D by hs and the generator identities hc, so its image in B tensor_R D is zero. Thus localization at t is localization at the original a_k image.

proof.text: Write P=R[x], Q=P[z], u_l=f_l-pi z_l and p_{kl}=a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl}. Modulo pi and after inverting a_k, the cleared relation expresses every f_l in the ideal of the f_j with j in E_k. The normalized p_{kl} for l in E_k are zero. Eliminate z_l for l outside E_k using p_{kl}=0.

proof.text: For another chart k prime and j in E_k, set b_j=a_{k prime}h_{klj}-sum_{j prime in E_{k prime}}h_{k prime,l,j prime}h_{k,j prime,j}. Comparing the expressions for a_k a_{k prime} f_l in the reduced conormal module gives sum b_j f_j=0. The specified basis on chart k makes every b_j zero in Cbar localized at a_k. Equality in localization clears a power of a_k, placing that multiple in I+pi^2P. In D/pi D all f_l are already zero. The expansion a_k p_{k prime,l}-a_{k prime}p_{kl}+sum h_{k prime,l,j prime}p_{k,j prime}=sum b_j z_j modulo pi therefore makes every extra p relation redundant.

proof.text: After the preceding variable elimination and redundancy calculation, the coefficient algebra is B tensor_R2 A[1/ak]. Indeed the kernel of epsilon is the reduced ideal generated by the f_l, tensoring the quotient commutes with imposing these relations, and the quotient R to R2 permits tensoring the coefficient quotient over R2. Localization commutes with scalar extension. Map each free z_j to itself and each complementary z_l to the a_k inverse coefficient sum; the two maps are inverse on original x_i and all z_l. Transport ULift via its algebra equivalence.

theorem popescu_zero_base_chart_polynomial (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (B : Type b) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) B]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) B]
    (hπ : algebraMap R B π = 0) (k : Fin d.r) (s : d.liftingAlgebra)
    (hs : Ideal.Quotient.mk _ s = c (d.ε (d.reduced (d.a k)))) :
    Nonempty (MvPolynomial (d.E k)
      (B ⊗[R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)]
        Localization.Away (d.reducedElement k)) ≃ₐ[B]
      Localization.Away
        (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := B) s))
